description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and sorcery spells.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {C}{C}.
Cormela dies, returning Footsteps of the Goryo from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Footsteps of the Goryo by paying {2}{B}, putting Cormela from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
